properties.notes: Redevelopment is now underway of the former doctor's surgery premises to provide 5 apartments following demolition (16/00275/FUL). Development is to be completed in 2019/20. A higher density flatted scheme is appropriate for the location on the edge of the town centre. A number of previous applications also relate to the site including approval for single dwelling (13/02887/FUL) and refusal of a 6 unit proposal (15/02484/FUL).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
